facts.text: The Sanderling is a beachfront retreat on the Outer Banks.

facts.text: The resort has Outer Banks architecture such as cedar-shake siding.

facts.excerpt: vacation rental homes for up to 16 guests with breathtaking views, private beach access, and exclusive resort amenities
